name: Conversations help
description: Help mode entries for the Conversations plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Conversations
entries.text: Short entry: value notes pulled out of Claude chats, claude.ai exports and transcribed voice sessions with Brett. A brief carries only the entries that match its task, never whole sessions. Local: no AI, no tokens.

entries.title: Read new sessions
entries.text: Reads what is new in every source now instead of waiting for the next round (every 10 minutes).

entries.title: Source
entries.text: Limit the search to Claude Code chats, claude.ai exports or voice recordings.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: Show rules, mistakes, decisions or requests.

entries.title: Add
entries.text: Saves the entry and value typed beside it, pinned so every brief carries it.

entries.title: Pin
entries.text: Every brief carries this entry, whatever its task.

entries.title: Unpin
entries.text: This entry goes into a brief only when it matches the task.

entries.title: Hide
entries.text: Takes an entry that isn't really a rule out of the ledger and out of every brief.

entries.title: Conversations settings
entries.text: Whether briefs carry matching entries, whether whole-session passages are stored, whether headless build runs are read, and whether AI may tidy entries.

entries.title: Index headless runs
entries.text: Off by default: build runs are agents talking to themselves. Their verbatim quote from Brett is always kept.

entries.title: Search the entries
entries.text: Type a few words; matching entries show best match first. Passages show too only when storing them is switched on.

entries.title: Entry
entries.text: The rule, mistake or decision in a few words.

entries.title: Value
entries.text: One line: what not to do and what to do instead.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves the edited entry and value.

entries.title: Entries in briefs
entries.text: On: every rules brief ends with the pinned entries and the entries that match its task (12 at most, about 1200 characters).

entries.title: Store passages
entries.text: Off by default: only entries are kept. On: session text is stored too for full-text search; it never goes into a brief. Switching it off deletes the stored text.

entries.title: AI
entries.text: Off by default (plain rules, zero tokens). On: the model rewrites up to 20 new entries per round from one sentence each, and the context pack gets a short answer.

steps.say: Short entry: value notes from every session with Brett.
A brief carries only the entries that match its task, never whole sessions.
